title: M2 — Native Renderer
goal: Present bounded glyph frames through wgpu with stable preview and procedural scenes.
entry_conditions: Stable core frame and font contracts; conversion prototype evidence available.
exit_conditions: Atlas/device-loss and resize paths are bounded and recover safely.

The bounded deterministic runtime contract (SCN-001) and documented v1 generators SCN-002..SCN-007 (matrix rain, starfield, waves, noise field, cube wireframe and solid) render through the native/preview renderer with validated v1 bounds, fixed-step seeded behavior, bounded state/catch-up, effective caps, reduced-motion/static variants and deterministic offline snapshots/exports; record actual per-preset p50/p95/p99 and peak-state-byte evidence without inventing measurements. Advanced SCN-008..SCN-011 and effects remain in M4 or later.
Static idle has no continuous redraw and CPU/GPU/frame-time baseline includes environment and binary hashes.
The E12 multi-trial media benchmark remains M4; M2 requires only its named-machine renderer baseline, with no universal performance claim.

title: M3 — Windows First Wallpaper
goal: Demonstrate a real below-icons Windows wallpaper with safe desktop interaction and lifecycle.
entry_conditions: QA-M2 preview accepted; Windows native surface spike approved.
exit_conditions: One named Windows tuple passes placement, icon/input preservation and Stop.

Explorer restart, lock/unlock, suspend/resume, hotplug, scaling and session recovery have reproducible evidence for the named Windows tuple; MON-001 owns typed output transforms/calibration, while COR-004/PWR-001 own bounded pause/resume primitives and WND-002 owns host recovery. Full multi-output assignment modes and ambiguous identity recovery remain scheduled in M5.

Portable transactional assignment state (COR-003) and failed native attachment (WND-002) restore the previous wallpaper or an explicitly safe static/preview fallback, never topmost fullscreen; full asynchronous native Apply/media integration remains scheduled in M5.
